verdict.rationale: Algolia's core InstantSearch libraries (JS/React) and quickstart docs are built explicitly for as-you-type search with typo tolerance, and multiple independent community reports corroborate millisecond, keystroke-level speed (e.g., 'Fast and instant', RAM-first index architecture cited as beating Elasticsearch/Solr for search-as-you-type). Missing for 10: no first-party published latency/SLA benchmark numbers specifically for keystroke response time (only qualitative claims and third-party anecdotes).
